### Definition: Conditional Probability
Content: P(A|B) = P(A intersection B) / P(B).
Assumptions: P(B) > 0
Symbols: P(A|B) = conditional probability
Exceptions: Undefined when P(B) = 0

### Theorem: Law of Total Probability
Content: P(B) = P(B|A)P(A) + P(B|not A)P(not A).
Assumptions: 0 < P(A) < 1
Dependencies: Conditional Probability

### Theorem: Bayes' Theorem
Content: P(A|B) = P(B|A) * P(A) / P(B).
Assumptions: P(B) > 0
Symbols: P(A|B) = posterior probability
Dependencies: Conditional Probability, Law of Total Probability
